mcqs.q: When were the Corn Laws repealed?
What caused the French Revolution of 1789?
options: Financial crisis from war debts, an unfair tax system burdening the Third Estate, Enlightenment ideas, and royal mismanagement of the Estates-General.
Lenin personally led the storming of the Winter Palace.
The starving poor stormed the Bastille and overthrew the king.
Napoleon led the revolution to replace the Bourbon monarchy.

mcqs.q: Why did the Industrial Revolution begin in Britain?
options: Because James Watt invented the steam engine.
A combination of capital from trade and empire, coal and iron deposits, agricultural improvements, political stability, and a culture of invention.
Because Britain banned slavery before other countries.
Lenin personally led the storming of the Winter Palace.
